title: Custom styles pptx 001
notes: PPTX has no named-paragraph-style API in python-pptx (style defs live in the theme/slideLayout chain, not as named per-paragraph styles like docx w:styles), so every variation here is DIRECT formatting: four paragraphs whose runs carry literal a:rPr size (32/28/18/12pt), b/i flags and srgbClr fills (ink 101A2E, slate 93A0B8, vermilion E2483A) — asserted in slide1.xml. Nothing references a custom layout or master placeholder; a style-table reader finds only the default python-pptx theme parts and must fall back to run-level properties.
